cover.report_type: Interim Report: Seven days before a general election

_meta.notes: Faxed handwritten form. TWO internal inconsistencies kept verbatim: Line 1 Column A reads 26400 but Line 4 ('from Line 1 Column A') reads 26570; Line 2 Column A reads 24763 but Line 6 ('from Line 2 Column A') reads 24673 (digits transposed). The balance summary is self-consistent with the Line 4/Line 6 figures (26570 - 24673 = 1,897 = Line 7). Nothing recomputed. The 'seven days before a primary election' box also carries a stray mark that is struck out; the general-election box is the one checked.

contributions.detail: delta 175.00 against the Summary Page Column A, and 5.00 against the schedule's own TOTAL - THREE FIGURES, ALL RETAINED. (a) The 6 rows sum 26575.00. (b) The printed Schedule A TOTAL is 26570 (the SUBTOTAL cell was left blank), which is 5.00 short of the rows; the same 26570 also appears at Summary line 1 Column B, line 4 and line 5, so it is the filer's own well-corroborated figure and the 5.00 gap is the filer's arithmetic. (c) Summary line 1 Column A - the stated figure - is 26400, which equals EXACTLY the five rows other than the 175.00 self-contribution on row 1, i.e. this filer's Column A appears to exclude that row. The 175 reading is corroborated: the same hand's 175 on Schedule B row 1 is confirmed to the cent by the Schedule B gate. Nothing was adjusted.

expenditures.detail: delta 175.00 - but the SCHEDULE gate fires exactly: the 9 rows sum 24938.00 = the printed SUBTOTAL 24 938 = the printed TOTAL 24938 (both re-read at 600 dpi). It is the Summary Page that disagrees with its own schedule: line 2 Column A reads 24763 and line 6 reads 24673 (a digit transposition of each other), while line 2 Column B reads 24938. 24938 - 24763 = 175.00, exactly the SL County fee row - the same exclusion pattern as the contributions side. Nothing was adjusted.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p4 (Schedule B) GATE FIRES EXACTLY: rows 24938.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 24 938 = printed TOTAL 24938. That gate is what settled the Media One amount (see escalations). p3 (Schedule A) WILL NOT GATE: rows sum 26575.00 against a printed TOTAL of 26570 (the SUBTOTAL cell is blank) - a 5.00 gap left standing after a 900 dpi cell crop, both figures named above and neither adjusted. Summary Page balance chain: line 3 (0) + line 4 (26570) = line 5 (26570); 26570 - line 6 (24673) = line 7 (1,897) - internally consistent, but around figures that differ from BOTH Column A and the schedules.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 Media One amount cell at 900 dpi (settled 2950, not 2450 - the page-subtotal identity demanded 500 more and the 900 dpi crop confirms a 9); p4 SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells at 600 dpi (both 24938, ruling out a 24958 mis-read); p3 row-1 amount cell at 900 dpi (reads 175, NOT 170 - so the 5.00 Schedule A gap was left open rather than closed by adjusting the row)
itemized.notes: 4-page FAX (banner on every page: '10/26/2010  00:34  18015329125  WAFCO  PAGE 0n/04'), heavily degraded, with a vertical fax artifact down the middle of each page. p1 cover: 'Seven days before a general election' checked with a large X; the 'Seven days before a primary election' box ALSO carries a heavy scribble/strike-out; NEITHER amendment box ticked; Steve Harmsen, Office 'CC #1', District D-1, party 'R'; signed 10/26/10, clerk-stamped OCT 26 2010. p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A (6 rows), p4 Schedule B (9 rows). GEOMETRY: pointers are given for Schedule B, where the ruling lines detect cleanly; they are OMITTED for Schedule A because that page's fax skew makes the row bands unreliable to convert - a wrong pointer is worse than none. Schedule B has one entirely BLANK ruled row between row 3 (Reagan Outdoor) and row 4 (Media One); it is not transcribed and the geometry skips it. TWO ROWS HAVE AN ILLEGIBLE DATE: Schedule A row 1 and Schedule B row 1 both carry the same scribbled month glyph over '/10' - blank + needs_review, no date inferred. Schedule B row 5 is dated 10/5/16 - a well-formed filer TYPO on a 2010 report; kept VERBATIM per contract, flagged. PRIVACY: three contributor rows print a street address with no city; only the one row that names a city/state (Caliente, NV) carries geography.
